# Denoising Search Query Improves Tourism Forecasting

<!-- generated by scripts/generate_topic_pages.py -->

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Wanyi Cao, Mingming Hu  
**Year:** 2025  
**Journal:** Annals of Tourism Research  
**DOI:** [10.1016/j.annals.2025.103892](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.annals.2025.103892)

**Keywords:** tourism forecasting, search query, denoising, demand prediction, big data

## Abstract

Proposes a denoising approach for search query data to improve tourism demand forecasting accuracy, demonstrating that noise-filtered search data significantly outperforms raw search data in predicting tourist arrivals.
